Find Rides button fully visible: bounding box y=714, height=54 => bottom=768 which is above the 844 viewport bottom and above the tab bar; not clipped.
Address rows compact: pickup-row and destination-row both render at height=46 with the smaller font as intended; sheet stays inside its 60% maxHeight (317px tall).
Regression normal ride: selected Disney Springs via destination-row picker, tapped Find Rides, navigated to /ride/{id} and offers screen loaded (3/5 offers visible).
